import Callout from '@/components/Callout';

Prometheus is cheap right up to the point where it is not, and the line between the two is almost never the number of samples.

## Part 1: What Prometheus stores

<Callout type="alert" title="Big Word Alert: time series">

A time series is one metric name plus one exact set of label values, and the sequence of timestamped numbers collected for it.

</Callout>

![The head block and the blocks on disk](/images/blogs/head-block.svg)

## Part 2: Where cardinality costs you

| Label | Why it explodes | Where it belongs instead |
|---|---|---|
| Pod name on an autoscaling fleet | Unique forever, replaced constantly | Logs, with the Pod name in the line |
| Request or trace ID | Unique per request | Traces or logs |

```promql
count by (__name__) ({__name__=~".+"})
```

<Callout type="note" title="Aside: this is Prometheus specifically">

Other time series stores make different trade-offs, but series count is the cost driver everywhere.

</Callout>
